profile.headline: iOS Engineer at Tinder
profile.summary: I’m an iOS Engineer with 4+ years of experience who is passionate about building products that drive user growth and engagement at scale. I’ve helped teams ship onboarding, engagement, and sharing experiences that reach millions of users. I thrive in cross-functional environments, driving projects end-to-end while mentoring teammates and improving developer velocity to deliver products people love.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Don't you hate going to a park and seeing an empty court or field? Driving all the way to find out nobody is even there. Don't waste your time any more and TeamUp!

ABOUT:
TeamUp was made to create a community that promotes physical and mental wellness in a fun and easy way. This app allows people to connect with others to engage in various sports. Users can see posts around their current location and also create post. TeamUp took an minimalistic approach to help users view,create, and connect with others.

FEEDBACK:
I would love to hear about any ideas or features you would like to see in future updates! Send us an email at TeamUp.iOS@gmail.com

positions.title: High School Math and Science Tutor
positions.description:
• Assisted 40-50 high school students daily with homework, test preparation, and material comprehension.  
• Developed and led Saturday study sessions focused on SAT and ACT preparation.  
• Provided practice tests and score improvement techniques to enhance student performance.  
• Contributed to the educational mission of the Boys and Girls Club of the Los Angeles Harbor, fostering a supportive learning environment.

courses.name: CS 162: Operating Systems and Systems Programming

projects.title: Isaac's Pizza Planet
projects.description: This iOS game is a 2-D game where the objective is to eat as many slices of pizza as possible. You have only 3 lifes and if any slices drops on the floor, you lose a life. Additionally, if you accidently eat the brocolli you will lose imedietley. Each 20 slices you eat, you will gain an additional life as well.

projects.title: Xpired
projects.description: Xpired was created to shine light on food waste around the world. Our goal was to combat food waste on a large scale through small scale applications. By using the methodologies from a development process called "Design Sprint", we were able to create a product that can combat this worldwide issue. Our product consisted of hardware and software that allowed us to connect to the user in a simple yet effective way. My team and I presented our product to over 200 students and staff at UC Berkeley as well as people from the tech industry.
